subject: Invoice submission: JSON-lines template and acknowledgement SLA
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <s.martin@acmecloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice ingestion options and sample payload

Hi Marcus,

We are kicking off Redwood integration for payments at Acme Cloud and want to confirm preferred invoice ingestion options. Our finance team can either: 1) upload invoices to your portal, or 2) send a JSON-lines file (one invoice per line) to an ingestion email/SFTP.

Attached is a small sample (sample_invoice.json) showing the fields we currently export from our ERP. A few specific questions:
- If we email JSON-lines, what exact field names do you need (PO number, entity id, line items array, tax breakdown)?
- Do you require the PO to be stamped on the PDF/attachment and/or included as a top-level field?
- What acknowledgement headers or subject token should we use so your system can auto-ack and map to a partner?
- Any duplicate detection or checksum recommendation?

We'd like to run a small pilot next week. Can you outline minimal acceptance criteria so our engineers can prepare exports?

Thanks,
Sophie Martin
Senior Finance Ops
Acme Cloud

Attachment: sample_invoice.json (example payload, minimal fields)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Martin <s.martin@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice ingestion options and sample payload

Hi Sophie — thanks for the sample. Portal-first is usually best for long-term visibility, but we can absolutely support an initial email-based JSON-lines intake for the pilot. Below is a suggested minimal JSON-lines schema and the operational ack expectations.

Minimal JSON-lines schema (one JSON object per line):
- invoice_id (string)
- invoice_date (ISO8601)
- amount_total (number, cents)
- currency (ISO code)
- po_number (string)
- vendor_tax_id (string)
- lines (array of objects with description, qty, unit_price_cents, line_total_cents)
- attachments (array of filenames; binary PDFs can be attached to the email)
- supplier_entity_id (string)  // if you manage multiple billing entities

File naming and subject token:
- Subject: inv:ACME:<supplier_entity_id>:<po_number>  (example: inv:ACME:ENT-23:PO-12345)
- Filename convention: <supplier_entity_id>_<po_number>_<yyyymmdd>.jsonl

Acknowledgements and SLA:
- We will emit a machine-readable ACK email with header X-Redwood-ACK: accepted/queued/failed and a JSON payload in the body.
- Pilot SLA: normal ACK within 2 business hours; for escalations we can set 1-hour SLAs (paid support).

Duplicate detection:
- Include checksum field (sha256) for the attached PDF or the JSON line. Our pipeline will de-duplicate on invoice_id + checksum + po_number.

Next steps:
1) If this schema works, attach one JSON-lines file using the filename convention to a test email next Tuesday.
2) We'll ingest to a staging queue and reply with the ACK and a mapping summary.

I've attached a starter template (redwood_minimal_invoice.jsonl) and linked a Drive example. Looping in Vanessa and Kimberly for any specific PO stamping or legal requirements.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Partnerships (Billing Integrations)
Redwood Inference

Hi Sophie — quick answers and confirmation before pilot: 

1) ACK payload: yes, we'll include a per-invoice status array in the ACK body with a short code and reason when relevant (example: [{"invoice_id":"inv-789","status":"accepted"},{"invoice_id":"inv-790","status":"failed","reason":"missing_tax_id"}]). The machine header will be X-Redwood-ACK: accepted and the ACK body will be application/json.

2) Multi-PO handling: preferred approach is one JSON-line per PO/invoice. If a single PDF legitimately needs to map to multiple POs, include multiple JSON-lines referencing the same attachment filename and different po_number values. That keeps idempotency straightforward.

3) SLA: Pilot ACK SLA = 2 business hours works for our queue. If Acme needs same-day guaranteed ACKs for early-morning batches, we can do 1-hour with a short support addendum.

Operational notes:
- Duplicate detection: we use invoice_id + checksum + po_number. If you can't generate invoice_id from ERP, we can accept supplier_reference + invoice_date + amount_total as a fallback for uniqueness.
- PDF stamping: optional. If stamped, include a stamped_pdf filename in attachments; our OCR still prefers unstamped but will accept stamped copies.
- Subject token required for auto-routing: inv:ACME:<supplier_entity_id>:<po_number>

Next step: send the test JSONL on 2026-05-18 to staging-invoices@redwoodinference.com with subject token as above. We'll open PROC-421 and share the ingestion log to your team.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

— Marcus
